category_hi: Sir, Dimag aur Naso ki Bimaariyan

symptoms.hi: Sir ke Ek Hisse mein Dard

care_en: Rest in a dark room and stay hydrated.
care_hi: Andhere kamre mein aaram karein aur paani piyein.

category_hi: Sir, Dimag aur Naso ki Bimaariyan

symptoms.hi: Haanth ya Pair mein Achanak Kamzori/Sunnpan
Kamar se Pair tak Nas ka Dard (Sciatica)

care_en: Rush to emergency hospital if sudden weakness occurs.
care_hi: Achanak sunnpan ya kamzori ho toh turant hospital jayein.

category_hi: Dil, Dhamni aur Naso ki Bimaariyan
disease_hi: Heart Blockage / Seene mein Dard / High BP

symptoms.hi: Seene mein Tez Dard ya Dabav
Baayein Haanth ya Jabde mein Dard

care_en: Go to nearest cardiac emergency immediately.
care_hi: Turant nazdeeki cardiac emergency hospital jayein.

category_hi: Dil, Dhamni aur Naso ki Bimaariyan
disease_en: DVT (Blood Clot) / Varicose Veins / Artery Blockage
disease_hi: Naso mein Khoon Jamna (DVT) / Varicose Veins

symptoms.hi: Ek Pair ya Pindli mein Sujan aur Dard
Chalne par Pairon mein Tez Dard

care_en: Do not massage swollen leg. Get a Doppler scan urgently.
care_hi: Sujan wale pair ki malish na karein, turant Doppler test karwayein.

disease_en: Muscle Stiffness / Cervical / Arthritis / Uric Acid
disease_hi: Muscle Stiffness / Cervical / Gathiya / Uric Acid
care_en: Apply warm compress and get Vitamin D, B12, and Uric Acid tested.
care_hi: Garm sikai karein aur Vitamin D, B12 aur Uric Acid test karwayein.

category_hi: Pet, Liver, Kidney aur Phephde (Internal Organs)

symptoms.hi: Pet ke Oopri Hisse mein Jalan ya Dard
Aankhon aur Twacha ka Peela Padna

care_en: Eat oil-free boiled food and get LFT and Ultrasound done.
care_hi: Bina tel-masale ka khana khayein aur LFT/Ultrasound karwayein.

category_hi: Pet, Liver, Kidney aur Phephde (Internal Organs)
disease_en: Kidney Stone / UTI / Pneumonia / Asthma / TB
disease_hi: Kidney Pathri / Urine Infection / Pneumonia / Dama / TB

symptoms.hi: Kamar ke Side mein Tez Dard (Kidney Stone)

care_en: Consult specialist for kidney and lung imaging tests.
care_hi: Kidney aur lungs ki jaanch ke liye turant doctor se milein.
